top.title: Rents in Dubai fall over 12%: Dubai Marina, Business Bay and JVC lead
top.teaser: Apartment rents in Dubai Marina, Business Bay, and Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC) saw a double-digit drop – the highest drop among Dubai communities – in the third quarter of 2026 as the property market softened, according to property consultancy Savills’ Q3 2026 report. Data showed that apartment rents in Marina, Business Bay, and JVC fell 12.8 per cent, 12.2 per cent and 10.4 per cent year-on-yea
top.impact_reason: Shifts investor rental yields and market sentiment.
top.headline: Dubai apartment rents drop over 12% in Q3
top.summary: Savills reports that Dubai Marina, Business Bay, and JVC experienced double-digit rental declines in the third quarter of 2026. This indicates a softening of the local property market.
top.why: Rental price shifts directly impact investor yields and tenant market dynamics.
